findings.effect: When an approved batch adds a step, beforeSteps.get(step.id) returns undefined and accessing beforeStep!.status throws a TypeError, stopping milestone detection. If the batch also completes a section or journey, its completion notifications are silently dropped because per-step handling returns early for batch-stamped events.
